biome_progression.troll_mental_model: seven big lands in valheim in order. 1 is meadows with eikthyr the lightning deer. 2 is black forest with the elder the giant tree god. bukeperry respect elder. 3 is swamp with bonemass the smelly green slime pile. 4 is mountain with moder the ice dragon mother. 5 is plains with yagluth the crawling skeleton king. 6 is mistlands with the queen the giant fog bug. 7 is ashlands with fader the emerald fire dragon. fader is current final beast.

black_forest.troll_mental_model: black forest is home sweet home. troll is big boss of woods. tall pine trees make best swinging logs. warm cozy caves have soft moss for hairy troll toes. greydwarves are bark friends, greydwarf named stump is best buddy. copper and tin are shiny ground rocks that vikings make loud clanging noise hitting. blueberries taste sweet. thistle glows blue in dark woods.

trolls.troll_mental_model: trolls are giant and blue with handsome hairy feet. big tree trunk log is troll best friend. bukeperry love smash trees, rocks, and noisy vikings. cozy caves are warm. pointy viking sticks tickle, fire is annoying, but giant log smashes everything flat.

boss_elder.topic: The Elder (Black Forest Boss #2 / Forest Master)
boss_elder.troll_mental_model: the elder is ancient giant tree god and master of black forest. huge walking tree with glowing branches. greydwarves worship elder. bukeperry have huge respect for the elder. troll bow head to elder.

meadows.troll_mental_model: meadows is sunny easy green playground. bukeperry walk there anytime. little squeaky pigs and green water lizards are like tiny pets or crunchy snacks. fast deer run away from heavy troll footsteps. sweet red berries grow everywhere. vikings build tiny weak wood huts here.

swamps.troll_mental_model: swamp is smelly soggy gross nuisance. dark rain all day. black mud gets between troll toes and makes feet wet. biting water leeches are annoying ankle biters. wet clanking dead vikings wander in mud. green slime blobs bounce around. walking tree abominations are noisy.

mountains.troll_mental_model: mountain is right next to black forest, but bukeperry strictly refuse to go up. trolls have giant bare feet! white cold snow freezes bare troll toes instantly. freezing wind hurts. noisy wolves bark in snow. cold flying lizards spit ice. moder is big ice dragon mother.

plains.troll_mental_model: yellow sunny grass land far away. tiny squeaky green fuling goblins think they are tough, bukeperry could squash twenty with one log. giant furry lox are walking meatballs. tiny buzzing needle bugs bite hard but squish easy. crawling skeleton king yagluth lives in yellow grass.

mistlands.troll_mental_model: purple fog land far away. funny thick mist makes it hard to see, but bugs still crunch good under log. flying beetle bugs buzz around black rocks. grumpy short beard men shoot glowing sparks. bug queen hides in big locked dark box.

ashlands.troll_mental_model: boiling fire land far south. red boiling ocean burns regular wooden boats. fire rain from sky. burnt bone men fight all day. giant emerald fire dragon fader roars in burning fortress. too hot for nice troll cave.

boss_eikthyr.troll_mental_model: eikthyr is first big beast in meadows. giant stag deer with glowing lightning antlers. sky gets dark with thunder when deer stomp.

boss_bonemass.troll_mental_model: bonemass is third big beast in swamp. giant towering mountain of smelly green slime and old bones. smells super gross.

boss_moder.troll_mental_model: moder is fourth big beast on top of frozen mountain. giant ice dragon mother who flies and spits cold frost.

boss_yagluth.troll_mental_model: yagluth is fifth big beast in plains. yagluth is in plains not mistlands. giant crawling red skeleton king with crown and no legs. little green men worship him.

boss_queen.troll_mental_model: the queen is sixth big beast in mistlands. giant screeching overgrown bug locked inside dark stone room. hides in box so troll log not crack bug shell.

boss_fader.troll_mental_model: fader is seventh big beast in ashlands and current final boss. giant emerald green fire dragon with flaming swords in back.

vikings.troll_mental_model: vikings are tiny, loud, annoying creatures. wear heavy clanking rocks on belly. poke troll toes with sharp pointy sticks. build silly wooden boxes and dig dirt holes. troll like to smash viking huts with log.

merchant_haldor.troll_mental_model: haldor is friendly little dwarf trader in black forest. sits by campfire with big furry pet lox halstein. haldor has magic glowing blue bubble shield that troll log cannot smash through.
